ruleDefinitions.name: Mount Execution With Hidepid Parameter
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects execution of the "mount" command with "hidepid" parameter to make invisible processes to other users from the system

sequences.query: (process_path = RGX("\\/mount$") AND (process_command_line = RGX(".*hidepid\\=2.*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ \\-o\\ .*")))
